subject: ExoVate renewal: price-hold request tied to usage milestones
messages:
From: Olga Petrov <olga.petrov@redwood.ai>
To: Caroline Diaz <caroline@exovate.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-09-03T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Renewal planning: proposal and price-hold framing

Hi Caroline —

Thanks again for the conversation yesterday. Attached is our updated renewal proposal (ExoVate_MA_plan_v3.pdf) that reflects the expanded capacity you mentioned and two protective options for you: a 9-month price-hold on the committed rate, or a 6-month price-hold plus a usage-triggered credit if consumption doesn’t meet the agreed minimums.

We put the key commercial points up front:
- Committed capacity: 120k GPU-hours/year (phased: 40k / 40k / 40k)
- Price-hold option A: 9 months at current unit rate (no change)
- Price-hold option B: 6 months + 10% credit if usage < 70% of committed after month 3
- Early expansion rights: you can add burst pool capacity at a fixed uplift price for the first 6 months

I’ve cc’d Ben and Laura to loop in pricing/legal if you want to lean into option B — we can model expected unit economics and the credit mechanics. Please send over the latest usage extract (monthly GPU-hours for last 12 months) if you want us to align the milestone thresholds precisely.

Attachments: ExoVate_MA_plan_v3.pdf (proposal)

Best,
Olga Petrov
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
olga.petrov@redwood.ai | +1 415-555-0123

--
Redwood Inference — Developer-first inference for reliable, low-latency LLM serving
From: Caroline Diaz <caroline@exovate.com>
To: Olga Petrov <olga.petrov@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-09-04T11:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Renewal planning: proposal and price-hold framing

Olga —

Thanks for the proposal. We like the flexibility but have a few asks before we move to a PO: 
1) We need a firm price-hold tied to milestones — ExoVate can commit to the 120k GPU-hours if there are clear ramp checkpoints.
2) If production adoption stalls, we’ll need a modest credit to offset the commitment risk.
3) Can the price-hold and the burst uplift be extended to our EU region (we’ll provide an approximate split)?

I attached a usage extract for the last 12 months so you can see the seasonality (usage_report_Q3.csv). Our preference is: start with a 9-month price-hold, but we’d like a safety credit that kicks in if utilization < 70% after month 3. Credit amount: target ~10% of monthly fees for the deficient months.

If you can put that in writing we can route to procurement and legal.

Regards,
Caroline Diaz
VP, Cloud Ops | ExoVate
caroline@exovate.com
Attachment: usage_report_Q3.csv
From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
To: Olga Petrov <olga.petrov@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-09-05T08:22:00-07:00
Subject: Re: ExoVate price-hold ask — internal proposal

Team —

Read Caroline’s note and the usage file. Quick thoughts:
- We can accept a 9-month price-hold at current committed unit rate, but tie the price-hold to the ramp schedule (e.g., 30% of committed by month 3, 65% by month 6, full by month 9). If milestones are missed, the 10% credit proposed by the customer is reasonable as a short-term protective measure.
- Operationally we should define the credit as a bill credit applied retroactively for the deficient months rather than a rate adjustment — that’s cleaner for revenue recognition and for our finance ops.
- Add EU region coverage clause: confirm that EU usage billed at a small regional uplift (3%). We can keep the price-hold on the base and allow region-specific uplift for burst usage.

I sketched a one-page Commercial Memo and started a DocuSign envelope (link below) targeted at procurement. Once Olga confirms the language I’ll route.

DocuSign draft: https://docusign.net/EXO-RDW-48392

Cheers,
Ben Carter
Enterprise Sales | Redwood Inference
ben.carter@redwood.ai
From: Olga Petrov <olga.petrov@redwood.ai>
To: Caroline Diaz <caroline@exovate.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>, Rajiv Menon <rajiv@exovate.com>
Date: 2026-09-06T10:45:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Renewal planning: proposal and price-hold framing

Caroline —

Thanks for the quick reply and for the usage extract — that really helps. Following Ben’s note, here’s the agreed framing we’d like confirmation on: 

1) Committed capacity: 120k GPU-hours/year (phased as previously outlined).
2) Price-hold: 9 months at current unit price (applies to the base committed rate).
3) Ramp milestones: month 3 >= 30% committed, month 6 >= 65% committed, month 9 >= 100% committed.
4) Credit mechanics: if actual monthly utilization < 70% of that month’s committed target during months 4–9, ExoVate receives a 10% credit of the invoiced fees attributable to the shortfall month(s). Credit is applied as a billing credit on the next invoice (not a rate change).
5) EU region: base price-hold applies. Burst or regional capacity may carry a 3% regional uplift; that uplift is not covered by the price-hold.
6) Early expansion: ExoVate can add capacity at the agreed uplift for up to 6 months; beyond that we reprice.

If this matches your expectation I’ll have Ben finalize the commercial memo and generate the PO/DocuSign for signatures. If you want to tweak credit % or the ramp targets we can run sensitivity quickly.

For visibility I’ve attached the proposal again and linked the HubSpot deal.

Attachments: ExoVate_MA_plan_v3.pdf
Links: https://hubspot.company/deal/48392, https://docusign.net/EXO-RDW-48392

Best,
Olga
--
Olga Petrov
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
olga.petrov@redwood.ai | +1 415-555-0123
From: Caroline Diaz <caroline@exovate.com>
To: Olga Petrov <olga.petrov@redwood.ai>
Cc: Rajiv Menon <rajiv@exovate.com>
Date: 2026-09-08T16:20:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Renewal planning: proposal and price-hold framing

Olga / Ben / Laura —

Thanks — that framing works for ExoVate with two small edits we need captured in the SOW/PO: 
- Price-hold term: we want the 9-month price-hold to be non-renewing (i.e., fixed for the initial 9 months only).
- Credit application: we accept the 10% billing credit for deficient months, provided it is capped at 3 months of credits total during the 9-month window.

If you can add those points to the DocuSign and send over the updated PO we’ll run it through procurement this week. Once we have the signed PO we’ll kick off the ramp plan with your CS team.

Appreciate the responsiveness.

Regards,
Caroline Diaz
VP, Cloud Ops | ExoVate
caroline@exovate.com
